nodes.description: Public token symbol state variable of MGUToken set in the constructor.
Public token name state variable of MGUToken set in the constructor.
Public decimals state variable of MGUToken set to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply state variable initialized in the MooguToken constructor.
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Owner address state variable inherited from Owned; set from msg.sender in the Owned constructor.
Pending owner address state variable used by transferOwnership and acceptOwnership.
SafeMath helper that adds two uints and requires the result to be greater than or equal to the first operand.
SafeMath helper that subtracts b from a after requiring b <= a.
SafeMath helper that multiplies two uints and requires overflow-free division check.
SafeMath helper that divides a by b after requiring b > 0.
Owned contract constructor that assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending new owner in newOwner.
Function that lets the pending newOwner claim ownership by checking msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor that configures symbol, name, decimals, total supply and pre-assigns the whole supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance locked at the zero address.
Returns the token balance of the supplied tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
ERC20 transfer that debits msg.sender and credits the recipient using safeSub and safeAdd.
ERC20 approve that writes the allowance for spender into allowed[msg.sender].
ERC20 transferFrom that debits the from balance and allowance and credits the recipient.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner from the allowed mapping.
Sets an allowance and then performs an external call to spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject Ether.
onlyOwner function that makes an external call to an arbitrary token contract to transfer tokens to owner.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, balance indexing and allowance writes.
Arithmetic addition c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a) inside safeAdd.
Arithmetic subtraction c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a) inside safeSub.
Arithmetic multiplication c = a * b guarded by a == 0 || c / a == b inside safeMul.
Arithmetic division c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0) inside safeDiv.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) with attacker-controlled target.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) against an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the balances mapping as the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key written into allowed by approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key for the allowance debit in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the owner key for the allowance and is forwarded to receiveApproval.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender to owner.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier that compares msg.sender to owner.
The Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable.
safeAdd contains the unchecked-by-compiler addition of the two operands.
safeSub contains the subtraction of the two operands.
safeMul contains the multiplication of the two operands.
safeDiv contains the division of the two operands.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance before crediting the recipient.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub on both the from balance and the caller allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the caller-supplied spender contract, which can re-enter the token.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes transfer on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract address.
The MooguToken constructor assigns _totalSupply = 100000000000000000000000000.
The constructor pre-assigns the entire supply into balances for the fixed deployer address.
The constructor writes symbol = "0MGU".
The constructor writes name = "0 Moogu Token".
The constructor writes decimals = 18.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply when computing the circulating supply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping for the given tokenOwner.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
approve writes the tokens value into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
approveAndCall writes tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
allowance reads the allowed mapping for tokenOwner and spender.
The Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership stores _newOwner into the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the require check and clears it to address(0).
acceptOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with the pending newOwner.

Parameter tokens is the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is the amount subtracted and added in transferFrom.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the external callback target.
Parameter tokens is the allowance value and forwarded to receiveApproval.
Parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable by transferOwnership.
Local c receives the result of the addition operation in safeAdd.
Local c receives the result of the subtraction operation in safeSub.
Local c receives the result of the multiplication operation in safeMul.
Local c receives the result of the division operation in safeDiv.
